+class CanonicalReader
+{
+public:
+    explicit CanonicalReader(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}
+
+    void Expect(std::string_view expected)
+    {
+        if (!text_.substr(position_).starts_with(expected))
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        position_ += expected.size();
+    }
+
+    std::string_view ReadUntil(std::string_view delimiter)
+    {
+        const std::size_t found = text_.find(delimiter, position_);
+        if (found == std::string_view::npos)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, found - position_);
+        position_ = found + delimiter.size();
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Read(std::size_t length)
+    {
+        if (length > text_.size() - position_)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, length);
+        position_ += length;
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Remaining() const
+    {
+        return text_.substr(position_);
+    }
+
+private:
+    std::string_view text_;
+    std::size_t position_ = 0;
+};
+
+template <typename Integer>
+Integer ParseCanonicalInteger(std::string_view text)
+{
+    Integer value{};
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(
+        text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        std::to_string(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+double ParseCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    double value = 0.0;
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(),
+        text.data() + text.size(), value, std::chars_format::general);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        CanonicalRecommendationDouble(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+std::optional<double> ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalDouble(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<long long> ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalInteger<long long>(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<std::string> ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return CanonicalExperimentDateText(std::string{text});
+}
+
+ExperimentInvocationConfiguration ParseSourceInvocation(
+    const std::string& canonical)
+{
+    CanonicalReader invocation{canonical};
+    invocation.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_invocation_v2;"
+        "semantic_configuration_length=");
+    const std::size_t semanticLength = ParseCanonicalInteger<std::size_t>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";semantic_configuration="));
+    const std::string semantic{invocation.Read(semanticLength)};
+    invocation.Expect(";checkpoint_interval=");
+    const int checkpointInterval = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";resume_model_id="));
+    const auto resumeModelId = ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+        invocation.Remaining());
+
+    CanonicalReader configuration{semantic};
+    configuration.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_semantic_configuration_v3;symbol=");
+    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration parsed;
+    parsed.configuration.symbol = std::string{
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";prediction_horizon=")};
+    parsed.configuration.predictionHorizon = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";label_threshold="));
+    parsed.configuration.labelThreshold = ParseCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";core_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.coreLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";head_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.headLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";target_epochs="));
+    parsed.configuration.targetEpochs = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";train_start_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.trainStartDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";train_end_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.trainEndDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_start_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.inferStartDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_end_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.inferEndDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.Remaining());
+    parsed.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
+    parsed.resumeModelId = resumeModelId;
+
+    const auto validated = BuildRecommendationInvocationIdentity(parsed);
+    if (validated.canonicalText != canonical)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return validated.invocation;
+}

+class StreamStateGuard
+{
+public:
+    explicit StreamStateGuard(std::ostream& stream)
+        : stream_(stream), flags_(stream.flags()),
+          precision_(stream.precision()), locale_(stream.getloc()) {}
+
+    ~StreamStateGuard()
+    {
+        try
+        {
+            stream_.flags(flags_);
+            stream_.precision(precision_);
+            stream_.imbue(locale_);
+        }
+        catch (...)
+        {
+        }
+    }
+
+private:
+    std::ostream& stream_;
+    const std::ios_base::fmtflags flags_;
+    const std::streamsize precision_;
+    const std::locale locale_;
+};

+class CanonicalReader
+{
+public:
+    explicit CanonicalReader(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}
+
+    void Expect(std::string_view expected)
+    {
+        if (!text_.substr(position_).starts_with(expected))
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        position_ += expected.size();
+    }
+
+    std::string_view ReadUntil(std::string_view delimiter)
+    {
+        const std::size_t found = text_.find(delimiter, position_);
+        if (found == std::string_view::npos)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, found - position_);
+        position_ = found + delimiter.size();
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Read(std::size_t length)
+    {
+        if (length > text_.size() - position_)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, length);
+        position_ += length;
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Remaining() const
+    {
+        return text_.substr(position_);
+    }
+
+private:
+    std::string_view text_;
+    std::size_t position_ = 0;
+};
+
+template <typename Integer>
+Integer ParseCanonicalInteger(std::string_view text)
+{
+    Integer value{};
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(
+        text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        std::to_string(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+double ParseCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    double value = 0.0;
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(),
+        text.data() + text.size(), value, std::chars_format::general);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        CanonicalRecommendationDouble(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+std::optional<double> ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalDouble(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<long long> ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalInteger<long long>(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<std::string> ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return CanonicalExperimentDateText(std::string{text});
+}
+
+ExperimentInvocationConfiguration ParseSourceInvocation(
+    const std::string& canonical)
+{
+    CanonicalReader invocation{canonical};
+    invocation.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_invocation_v2;"
+        "semantic_configuration_length=");
+    const std::size_t semanticLength = ParseCanonicalInteger<std::size_t>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";semantic_configuration="));
+    const std::string semantic{invocation.Read(semanticLength)};
+    invocation.Expect(";checkpoint_interval=");
+    const int checkpointInterval = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";resume_model_id="));
+    const auto resumeModelId = ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+        invocation.Remaining());
+
+    CanonicalReader configuration{semantic};
+    configuration.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_semantic_configuration_v3;symbol=");
+    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration parsed;
+    parsed.configuration.symbol = std::string{
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";prediction_horizon=")};
+    parsed.configuration.predictionHorizon = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";label_threshold="));
+    parsed.configuration.labelThreshold = ParseCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";core_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.coreLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";head_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.headLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";target_epochs="));
+    parsed.configuration.targetEpochs = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";train_start_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.trainStartDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";train_end_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.trainEndDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_start_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.inferStartDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_end_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.inferEndDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.Remaining());
+    parsed.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
+    parsed.resumeModelId = resumeModelId;
+
+    const auto validated = BuildRecommendationInvocationIdentity(parsed);
+    if (validated.canonicalText != canonical)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return validated.invocation;
+}

+class StreamStateGuard
+{
+public:
+    explicit StreamStateGuard(std::ostream& stream)
+        : stream_(stream), flags_(stream.flags()),
+          precision_(stream.precision()), locale_(stream.getloc()) {}

   LSTM_Release \
     --recommendation-campaign-outcome-assessment=MATERIALIZATION_ID

The separated option form is also accepted.  The command is intrinsically
read-only, so ``--yes`` and ``--dry-run`` are rejected.  Output begins with one
``RECOMMENDATION_CAMPAIGN_OUTCOME_ASSESSMENT`` record and then one
``RECOMMENDATION_CAMPAIGN_OUTCOME_ASSESSMENT_MEMBER`` record per exact
materialized ordinal.  Records expose contract and identity hashes, the exact
Step 5a aggregate classification and counts, lifecycle, separate input and
final consistency, diagnostics, provenance, contexts, metrics, comparisons,
explicit ``null`` values, percent-encoded variable text, the materialization's
persisted campaign-approval hash, and explicit no-write/no-scheduler/no-
success/no-follow-up safety fields.

No schema migration or privilege change is required.  The assessment remains
point-in-time and non-persistent; Step 5b inserts, updates, deletes, activates,
queues, retries, and launches nothing and authorizes no follow-up.

+class CanonicalReader
+{
+public:
+    explicit CanonicalReader(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}
+
+    void Expect(std::string_view expected)
+    {
+        if (!text_.substr(position_).starts_with(expected))
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        position_ += expected.size();
+    }
+
+    std::string_view ReadUntil(std::string_view delimiter)
+    {
+        const std::size_t found = text_.find(delimiter, position_);
+        if (found == std::string_view::npos)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, found - position_);
+        position_ = found + delimiter.size();
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Read(std::size_t length)
+    {
+        if (length > text_.size() - position_)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, length);
+        position_ += length;
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Remaining() const
+    {
+        return text_.substr(position_);
+    }
+
+private:
+    std::string_view text_;
+    std::size_t position_ = 0;
+};
+
+template <typename Integer>
+Integer ParseCanonicalInteger(std::string_view text)
+{
+    Integer value{};
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(
+        text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        std::to_string(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+double ParseCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    double value = 0.0;
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(),
+        text.data() + text.size(), value, std::chars_format::general);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        CanonicalRecommendationDouble(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+std::optional<double> ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalDouble(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<long long> ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalInteger<long long>(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<std::string> ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return CanonicalExperimentDateText(std::string{text});
+}
+
+ExperimentInvocationConfiguration ParseSourceInvocation(
+    const std::string& canonical)
+{
+    CanonicalReader invocation{canonical};
+    invocation.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_invocation_v2;"
+        "semantic_configuration_length=");
+    const std::size_t semanticLength = ParseCanonicalInteger<std::size_t>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";semantic_configuration="));
+    const std::string semantic{invocation.Read(semanticLength)};
+    invocation.Expect(";checkpoint_interval=");
+    const int checkpointInterval = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";resume_model_id="));
+    const auto resumeModelId = ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+        invocation.Remaining());
+
+    CanonicalReader configuration{semantic};
+    configuration.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_semantic_configuration_v3;symbol=");
+    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration parsed;
+    parsed.configuration.symbol = std::string{
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";prediction_horizon=")};
+    parsed.configuration.predictionHorizon = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";label_threshold="));
+    parsed.configuration.labelThreshold = ParseCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";core_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.coreLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";head_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.headLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";target_epochs="));
+    parsed.configuration.targetEpochs = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";train_start_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.trainStartDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";train_end_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.trainEndDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_start_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.inferStartDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_end_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.inferEndDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.Remaining());
+    parsed.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
+    parsed.resumeModelId = resumeModelId;
+
+    const auto validated = BuildRecommendationInvocationIdentity(parsed);
+    if (validated.canonicalText != canonical)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return validated.invocation;
+}

+class StreamStateGuard
+{
+public:
+    explicit StreamStateGuard(std::ostream& stream)
+        : stream_(stream), flags_(stream.flags()),
+          precision_(stream.precision()), locale_(stream.getloc()) {}

+class CanonicalReader
+{
+public:
+    explicit CanonicalReader(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}
+
+    void Expect(std::string_view expected)
+    {
+        if (!text_.substr(position_).starts_with(expected))
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        position_ += expected.size();
+    }
+
+    std::string_view ReadUntil(std::string_view delimiter)
+    {
+        const std::size_t found = text_.find(delimiter, position_);
+        if (found == std::string_view::npos)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, found - position_);
+        position_ = found + delimiter.size();
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Read(std::size_t length)
+    {
+        if (length > text_.size() - position_)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, length);
+        position_ += length;
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Remaining() const
+    {
+        return text_.substr(position_);
+    }
+
+private:
+    std::string_view text_;
+    std::size_t position_ = 0;
+};
+
+template <typename Integer>
+Integer ParseCanonicalInteger(std::string_view text)
+{
+    Integer value{};
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(
+        text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        std::to_string(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+double ParseCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    double value = 0.0;
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(),
+        text.data() + text.size(), value, std::chars_format::general);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        CanonicalRecommendationDouble(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+std::optional<double> ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalDouble(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<long long> ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalInteger<long long>(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<std::string> ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return CanonicalExperimentDateText(std::string{text});
+}
+
+ExperimentInvocationConfiguration ParseSourceInvocation(
+    const std::string& canonical)
+{
+    CanonicalReader invocation{canonical};
+    invocation.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_invocation_v2;"
+        "semantic_configuration_length=");
+    const std::size_t semanticLength = ParseCanonicalInteger<std::size_t>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";semantic_configuration="));
+    const std::string semantic{invocation.Read(semanticLength)};
+    invocation.Expect(";checkpoint_interval=");
+    const int checkpointInterval = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";resume_model_id="));
+    const auto resumeModelId = ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+        invocation.Remaining());
+
+    CanonicalReader configuration{semantic};
+    configuration.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_semantic_configuration_v3;symbol=");
+    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration parsed;
+    parsed.configuration.symbol = std::string{
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";prediction_horizon=")};
+    parsed.configuration.predictionHorizon = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";label_threshold="));
+    parsed.configuration.labelThreshold = ParseCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";core_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.coreLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";head_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.headLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";target_epochs="));
+    parsed.configuration.targetEpochs = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";train_start_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.trainStartDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";train_end_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.trainEndDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_start_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.inferStartDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_end_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.inferEndDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.Remaining());
+    parsed.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
+    parsed.resumeModelId = resumeModelId;
+
+    const auto validated = BuildRecommendationInvocationIdentity(parsed);
+    if (validated.canonicalText != canonical)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return validated.invocation;
+}

+class StreamStateGuard
+{
+public:
+    explicit StreamStateGuard(std::ostream& stream)
+        : stream_(stream), flags_(stream.flags()),
+          precision_(stream.precision()), locale_(stream.getloc()) {}
+
+    ~StreamStateGuard()
+    {
+        try
+        {

+        {
+        }
+    }

+    const std::ios_base::fmtflags flags_;

+    const std::locale locale_;

+class CanonicalReader
+{
+public:
+    explicit CanonicalReader(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}
+
+    void Expect(std::string_view expected)
+    {
+        if (!text_.substr(position_).starts_with(expected))
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        position_ += expected.size();
+    }
+
+    std::string_view ReadUntil(std::string_view delimiter)
+    {
+        const std::size_t found = text_.find(delimiter, position_);
+        if (found == std::string_view::npos)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, found - position_);
+        position_ = found + delimiter.size();
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Read(std::size_t length)
+    {
+        if (length > text_.size() - position_)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, length);
+        position_ += length;
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Remaining() const
+    {
+        return text_.substr(position_);
+    }
+
+private:
+    std::string_view text_;
+    std::size_t position_ = 0;
+};
+
+template <typename Integer>
+Integer ParseCanonicalInteger(std::string_view text)
+{
+    Integer value{};
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(
+        text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        std::to_string(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+double ParseCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    double value = 0.0;
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(),
+        text.data() + text.size(), value, std::chars_format::general);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        CanonicalRecommendationDouble(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+std::optional<double> ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalDouble(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<long long> ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalInteger<long long>(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<std::string> ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return CanonicalExperimentDateText(std::string{text});
+}
+
+ExperimentInvocationConfiguration ParseSourceInvocation(
+    const std::string& canonical)
+{
+    CanonicalReader invocation{canonical};
+    invocation.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_invocation_v2;"
+        "semantic_configuration_length=");
+    const std::size_t semanticLength = ParseCanonicalInteger<std::size_t>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";semantic_configuration="));
+    const std::string semantic{invocation.Read(semanticLength)};
+    invocation.Expect(";checkpoint_interval=");
+    const int checkpointInterval = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";resume_model_id="));
+    const auto resumeModelId = ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+        invocation.Remaining());
+
+    CanonicalReader configuration{semantic};
+    configuration.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_semantic_configuration_v3;symbol=");
+    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration parsed;
+    parsed.configuration.symbol = std::string{
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";prediction_horizon=")};
+    parsed.configuration.predictionHorizon = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";label_threshold="));
+    parsed.configuration.labelThreshold = ParseCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";core_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.coreLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";head_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.headLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";target_epochs="));
+    parsed.configuration.targetEpochs = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";train_start_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.trainStartDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";train_end_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.trainEndDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_start_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.inferStartDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_end_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.inferEndDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.Remaining());
+    parsed.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
+    parsed.resumeModelId = resumeModelId;
+
+    const auto validated = BuildRecommendationInvocationIdentity(parsed);
+    if (validated.canonicalText != canonical)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return validated.invocation;
+}

+class StreamStateGuard
+{
+public:
+    explicit StreamStateGuard(std::ostream& stream)
+        : stream_(stream), flags_(stream.flags()),
+          precision_(stream.precision()), locale_(stream.getloc()) {}
+
+    ~StreamStateGuard()

+class CanonicalReader
+{
+public:
+    explicit CanonicalReader(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}
+
+    void Expect(std::string_view expected)
+    {
+        if (!text_.substr(position_).starts_with(expected))
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        position_ += expected.size();
+    }
+
+    std::string_view ReadUntil(std::string_view delimiter)
+    {
+        const std::size_t found = text_.find(delimiter, position_);
+        if (found == std::string_view::npos)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, found - position_);
+        position_ = found + delimiter.size();
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Read(std::size_t length)
+    {
+        if (length > text_.size() - position_)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, length);
+        position_ += length;
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Remaining() const
+    {
+        return text_.substr(position_);
+    }
+
+private:
+    std::string_view text_;
+    std::size_t position_ = 0;
+};
+
+template <typename Integer>
+Integer ParseCanonicalInteger(std::string_view text)
+{
+    Integer value{};
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(
+        text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        std::to_string(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+double ParseCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    double value = 0.0;
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(),
+        text.data() + text.size(), value, std::chars_format::general);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        CanonicalRecommendationDouble(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+std::optional<double> ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalDouble(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<long long> ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalInteger<long long>(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<std::string> ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return CanonicalExperimentDateText(std::string{text});
+}
+
+ExperimentInvocationConfiguration ParseSourceInvocation(
+    const std::string& canonical)
+{
+    CanonicalReader invocation{canonical};
+    invocation.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_invocation_v2;"
+        "semantic_configuration_length=");
+    const std::size_t semanticLength = ParseCanonicalInteger<std::size_t>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";semantic_configuration="));
+    const std::string semantic{invocation.Read(semanticLength)};
+    invocation.Expect(";checkpoint_interval=");
+    const int checkpointInterval = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";resume_model_id="));
+    const auto resumeModelId = ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+        invocation.Remaining());
+
+    CanonicalReader configuration{semantic};
+    configuration.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_semantic_configuration_v3;symbol=");
+    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration parsed;
+    parsed.configuration.symbol = std::string{
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";prediction_horizon=")};
+    parsed.configuration.predictionHorizon = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";label_threshold="));
+    parsed.configuration.labelThreshold = ParseCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";core_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.coreLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";head_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.headLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";target_epochs="));
+    parsed.configuration.targetEpochs = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";train_start_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.trainStartDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";train_end_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.trainEndDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_start_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.inferStartDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_end_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.inferEndDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.Remaining());
+    parsed.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
+    parsed.resumeModelId = resumeModelId;
+
+    const auto validated = BuildRecommendationInvocationIdentity(parsed);
+    if (validated.canonicalText != canonical)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return validated.invocation;
+}

+class CanonicalReader
+{
+public:
+    explicit CanonicalReader(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}
+
+    void Expect(std::string_view expected)
+    {
+        if (!text_.substr(position_).starts_with(expected))
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        position_ += expected.size();
+    }
+
+    std::string_view ReadUntil(std::string_view delimiter)
+    {
+        const std::size_t found = text_.find(delimiter, position_);
+        if (found == std::string_view::npos)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, found - position_);
+        position_ = found + delimiter.size();
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Read(std::size_t length)
+    {
+        if (length > text_.size() - position_)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, length);
+        position_ += length;
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Remaining() const
+    {
+        return text_.substr(position_);
+    }
+
+private:
+    std::string_view text_;
+    std::size_t position_ = 0;
+};
+
+template <typename Integer>
+Integer ParseCanonicalInteger(std::string_view text)
+{
+    Integer value{};
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(
+        text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        std::to_string(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+double ParseCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    double value = 0.0;
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(),
+        text.data() + text.size(), value, std::chars_format::general);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        CanonicalRecommendationDouble(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+std::optional<double> ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalDouble(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<long long> ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalInteger<long long>(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<std::string> ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return CanonicalExperimentDateText(std::string{text});
+}
+
+ExperimentInvocationConfiguration ParseSourceInvocation(
+    const std::string& canonical)
+{
+    CanonicalReader invocation{canonical};
+    invocation.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_invocation_v2;"
+        "semantic_configuration_length=");
+    const std::size_t semanticLength = ParseCanonicalInteger<std::size_t>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";semantic_configuration="));
+    const std::string semantic{invocation.Read(semanticLength)};
+    invocation.Expect(";checkpoint_interval=");
+    const int checkpointInterval = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";resume_model_id="));
+    const auto resumeModelId = ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+        invocation.Remaining());
+
+    CanonicalReader configuration{semantic};
+    configuration.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_semantic_configuration_v3;symbol=");
+    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration parsed;
+    parsed.configuration.symbol = std::string{
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";prediction_horizon=")};
+    parsed.configuration.predictionHorizon = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";label_threshold="));
+    parsed.configuration.labelThreshold = ParseCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";core_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.coreLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";head_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.headLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";target_epochs="));
+    parsed.configuration.targetEpochs = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";train_start_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.trainStartDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";train_end_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.trainEndDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_start_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.inferStartDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_end_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.inferEndDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.Remaining());
+    parsed.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
+    parsed.resumeModelId = resumeModelId;
+
+    const auto validated = BuildRecommendationInvocationIdentity(parsed);
+    if (validated.canonicalText != canonical)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return validated.invocation;
+}

diff --git a/docs/Phase5ExperimentRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessment.rst b/docs/Phase5ExperimentRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessment.rst

--- a/docs/Phase5ExperimentRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessment.rst

@@ -58,3 +58,76 @@ Non-goals
 Step 5a does not provide a repository, database access, persistence, service,
 CLI, scheduler, worker, filesystem behavior, campaign-success policy, or
 follow-up authorization.
+
+Step 5b authoritative integration
+---------------------------------
+
+Step 5b supplies the read-only integration without changing the Step 5a domain
+boundary.  One PostgreSQL ``REPEATABLE READ``, ``READ ONLY`` transaction loads
+the exact materialization through the Phase 4D production loader, loads its
+exact campaign approval, and obtains lifecycle and workflow consistency from
+the existing Phase 5 campaign-status projection.  It does not reconstruct a
+second lifecycle classifier.
+
+The Step 5a campaign identity is the persisted approval canonical text and
+hash.  Its materialization input receives the materialization row's persisted
+``approval_identity_hash`` unchanged, so Step 5a verifies the approval-to-
+materialization binding.  Exact materialization member ordinal, member ID,
+ranking-member ID, recommendation ID, source-experiment ID, proposal ID, and
+the execution-linked expected experiment ID flow from the validated status
+snapshot.  A status member reported as inconsistent is passed to Step 5a as
+``inputConsistency=inconsistent``; Step 5b neither repairs nor normalizes the
+upstream evidence.
+
+Scientific evidence
+-------------------
+
+Source evidence follows the materialized recommendation's persisted source
+experiment, model, and analysis identities.  Source final-inference selection
+uses the immutable source invocation canonical text captured by the exact
+persisted Phase 4C proposal; it never substitutes the source experiment's
+current configuration.  Result evidence follows the exact conversion-
+execution experiment, its current linked model, and its final inference and
+final analysis rows.  The comparison context is taken from the selected
+persisted final inference identity: canonical symbol, prediction horizon,
+threshold, persisted window size, the versioned
+``inference_eval_result_label_v1`` representation of the
+``label_rule_id``/``target_type`` pair, and canonical ``YYYY-MM-DD`` inference
+range.
+
+The version-1 Step 5b mapping carries ``inference_accuracy`` and
+``leader_score`` with ``NumericDelta`` support.  The source values are the
+immutable values captured on the recommendation; result values are the final
+analysis values.  Missing analysis or metric evidence remains absent or null,
+and changed contexts remain non-comparable.  No metric is recomputed and no
+campaign-success threshold is applied.
+
+Other persisted analysis fields were deliberately not mapped in this version:
+the immutable recommendation does not retain a directly corresponding value
+with the same scientific meaning.  In particular, Step 5b does not reconstruct
+predicted-neutral proportions or evidence totals from result counts.  Such
+values therefore cannot be mistaken for a valid numeric delta.
+
+CLI and output
+--------------
+
+::
+
+   LSTM_Release \
+     --recommendation-campaign-outcome-assessment=MATERIALIZATION_ID
+
+The separated option form is also accepted.  The command is intrinsically
+read-only, so ``--yes`` and ``--dry-run`` are rejected.  Output begins with one
+``RECOMMENDATION_CAMPAIGN_OUTCOME_ASSESSMENT`` record and then one
+``RECOMMENDATION_CAMPAIGN_OUTCOME_ASSESSMENT_MEMBER`` record per exact
+materialized ordinal.  Records expose contract and identity hashes, the exact
+Step 5a aggregate classification and counts, lifecycle, separate input and
+final consistency, diagnostics, provenance, contexts, metrics, comparisons,
+explicit evidence/context-presence booleans and ``null`` values,
+percent-encoded variable text, the materialization's persisted campaign-
+approval hash, and explicit no-write/no-scheduler/no-success/no-follow-up
+safety fields.
+
+No schema migration or privilege change is required.  The assessment remains
+point-in-time and non-persistent; Step 5b inserts, updates, deletes, activates,
+queues, retries, and launches nothing and authorizes no follow-up.

+class CanonicalReader
+{
+public:
+    explicit CanonicalReader(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}
+
+    void Expect(std::string_view expected)
+    {
+        if (!text_.substr(position_).starts_with(expected))
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        position_ += expected.size();
+    }
+
+    std::string_view ReadUntil(std::string_view delimiter)
+    {
+        const std::size_t found = text_.find(delimiter, position_);
+        if (found == std::string_view::npos)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, found - position_);
+        position_ = found + delimiter.size();
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Read(std::size_t length)
+    {
+        if (length > text_.size() - position_)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, length);
+        position_ += length;
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Remaining() const
+    {
+        return text_.substr(position_);
+    }
+
+private:
+    std::string_view text_;
+    std::size_t position_ = 0;
+};
+
+template <typename Integer>
+Integer ParseCanonicalInteger(std::string_view text)
+{
+    Integer value{};
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(
+        text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        std::to_string(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+double ParseCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    double value = 0.0;
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(),
+        text.data() + text.size(), value, std::chars_format::general);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        CanonicalRecommendationDouble(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+std::optional<double> ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalDouble(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<long long> ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalInteger<long long>(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<std::string> ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return CanonicalExperimentDateText(std::string{text});
+}
+
+ExperimentInvocationConfiguration ParseSourceInvocation(
+    const std::string& canonical)
+{
+    CanonicalReader invocation{canonical};
+    invocation.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_invocation_v2;"
+        "semantic_configuration_length=");
+    const std::size_t semanticLength = ParseCanonicalInteger<std::size_t>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";semantic_configuration="));
+    const std::string semantic{invocation.Read(semanticLength)};
+    invocation.Expect(";checkpoint_interval=");
+    const int checkpointInterval = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";resume_model_id="));
+    const auto resumeModelId = ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+        invocation.Remaining());
+
+    CanonicalReader configuration{semantic};
+    configuration.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_semantic_configuration_v3;symbol=");
+    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration parsed;
+    parsed.configuration.symbol = std::string{
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";prediction_horizon=")};
+    parsed.configuration.predictionHorizon = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";label_threshold="));
+    parsed.configuration.labelThreshold = ParseCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";core_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.coreLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";head_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.headLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";target_epochs="));
+    parsed.configuration.targetEpochs = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";train_start_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.trainStartDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";train_end_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.trainEndDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_start_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.inferStartDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_end_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.inferEndDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.Remaining());
+    parsed.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
+    parsed.resumeModelId = resumeModelId;
+
+    const auto validated = BuildRecommendationInvocationIdentity(parsed);
+    if (validated.canonicalText != canonical)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return validated.invocation;
+}

    59	template <typename Values>
    60	std::pair<std::string, pqxx::params> IdPlaceholders(const Values& values)
    61	{
    62	    pqxx::params parameters;
    63	    std::ostringstream placeholders;
    64	    std::size_t index = 0;
    65	    for (const auto value : values)
    66	    {
    67	        if (index != 0) placeholders << ',';
    68	        placeholders << '$' << index + 1;
    69	        parameters.append(value);
    70	        ++index;
    71	    }
    72	    return {placeholders.str(), std::move(parameters)};
    73	}

   124	class CanonicalReader
   125	{
   126	public:
   127	    explicit CanonicalReader(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}
   128	
   129	    void Expect(std::string_view expected)
   130	    {
   131	        if (!text_.substr(position_).starts_with(expected))
   132	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   133	                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
   134	        position_ += expected.size();
   135	    }
   136	
   137	    std::string_view ReadUntil(std::string_view delimiter)
   138	    {
   139	        const std::size_t found = text_.find(delimiter, position_);
   140	        if (found == std::string_view::npos)
   141	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   142	                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
   143	        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, found - position_);
   144	        position_ = found + delimiter.size();
   145	        return value;
   146	    }
   147	
   148	    std::string_view Read(std::size_t length)
   149	    {
   150	        if (length > text_.size() - position_)
   151	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   152	                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
   153	        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, length);
   154	        position_ += length;
   155	        return value;
   156	    }
   157	
   158	    std::string_view Remaining() const
   159	    {
   160	        return text_.substr(position_);
   161	    }
   162	
   163	private:
   164	    std::string_view text_;
   165	    std::size_t position_ = 0;
   166	};
   167	
   168	template <typename Integer>
   169	Integer ParseCanonicalInteger(std::string_view text)
   170	{
   171	    Integer value{};
   172	    const auto result = std::from_chars(
   173	        text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
   174	    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
   175	        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
   176	        std::to_string(value) != text)
   177	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   178	            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
   179	    return value;
   180	}
   181	
   182	double ParseCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
   183	{
   184	    double value = 0.0;
   185	    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(),
   186	        text.data() + text.size(), value, std::chars_format::general);
   187	    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
   188	        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
   189	        CanonicalRecommendationDouble(value) != text)
   190	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   191	            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
   192	    return value;
   193	}
   194	
   195	std::optional<double> ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
   196	{
   197	    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
   198	    return ParseCanonicalDouble(text);
   199	}
   200	
   201	std::optional<long long> ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
   202	    std::string_view text)
   203	{
   204	    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
   205	    return ParseCanonicalInteger<long long>(text);
   206	}
   207	
   208	std::optional<std::string> ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
   209	    std::string_view text)
   210	{
   211	    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
   212	    return CanonicalExperimentDateText(std::string{text});
   213	}
   214	
   215	ExperimentInvocationConfiguration ParseSourceInvocation(
   216	    const std::string& canonical)
   217	{
   218	    CanonicalReader invocation{canonical};
   219	    invocation.Expect(
   220	        "experiment_recommendation_invocation_v2;"
   221	        "semantic_configuration_length=");
   222	    const std::size_t semanticLength = ParseCanonicalInteger<std::size_t>(
   223	        invocation.ReadUntil(";semantic_configuration="));
   224	    const std::string semantic{invocation.Read(semanticLength)};
   225	    invocation.Expect(";checkpoint_interval=");
   226	    const int checkpointInterval = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
   227	        invocation.ReadUntil(";resume_model_id="));
   228	    const auto resumeModelId = ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
   229	        invocation.Remaining());
   230	
   231	    CanonicalReader configuration{semantic};
   232	    configuration.Expect(
   233	        "experiment_recommendation_semantic_configuration_v3;symbol=");
   234	    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration parsed;
   235	    parsed.configuration.symbol = std::string{
   236	        configuration.ReadUntil(";prediction_horizon=")};
   237	    parsed.configuration.predictionHorizon = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
   238	        configuration.ReadUntil(";label_threshold="));
   239	    parsed.configuration.labelThreshold = ParseCanonicalDouble(
   240	        configuration.ReadUntil(";core_lr_mult="));
   241	    parsed.configuration.coreLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
   242	        configuration.ReadUntil(";head_lr_mult="));
   243	    parsed.configuration.headLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
   244	        configuration.ReadUntil(";target_epochs="));
   245	    parsed.configuration.targetEpochs = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
   246	        configuration.ReadUntil(";train_start_date="));
   247	    parsed.configuration.trainStartDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
   248	        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";train_end_date=")});
   249	    parsed.configuration.trainEndDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
   250	        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_start_date=")});
   251	    parsed.configuration.inferStartDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
   252	        configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_end_date="));
   253	    parsed.configuration.inferEndDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
   254	        configuration.Remaining());
   255	    parsed.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
   256	    parsed.resumeModelId = resumeModelId;
   257	
   258	    const auto validated = BuildRecommendationInvocationIdentity(parsed);
   259	    if (validated.canonicalText != canonical)
   260	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   261	            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
   262	    return validated.invocation;
   263	}
   264	
   265	std::map<long long, SourceRecord> LoadSources(
   266	    pqxx::transaction_base& transaction,
   267	    const std::vector<long long>& recommendationIds)
   268	{
   269	    if (recommendationIds.empty()) return {};
   270	    const auto [placeholders, parameters] =
   271	        IdPlaceholders(recommendationIds);
   272	    const pqxx::result rows = transaction.exec(
   273	        "SELECT recommendation_id,source_experiment_id,source_model_id,"
   274	        "source_analysis_id,source_symbol,source_prediction_horizon,"
   275	        "source_leader_score,source_infer_accuracy "
   276	        "FROM experiment_recommendation WHERE recommendation_id IN (" +
   277	            placeholders + ") ORDER BY recommendation_id;",
   278	        parameters);
   279	    std::map<long long, SourceRecord> result;
   280	    for (const auto& row : rows)
   281	    {
   282	        SourceRecord value;
   283	        value.recommendationId = row["recommendation_id"].as<long long>();
   284	        value.sourceExperimentId =
   285	            row["source_experiment_id"].as<long long>();
   286	        value.sourceModelId = OptionalValue<long long>(row, "source_model_id");
   287	        value.sourceAnalysisId =
   288	            OptionalValue<long long>(row, "source_analysis_id");
   289	        value.sourceSymbol = row["source_symbol"].as<std::string>();
   290	        value.sourcePredictionHorizon =
   291	            row["source_prediction_horizon"].as<int>();
   292	        value.leaderScore =
   293	            OptionalValue<double>(row, "source_leader_score");
   294	        value.inferenceAccuracy =
   295	            OptionalValue<double>(row, "source_infer_accuracy");
   296	        if (!result.emplace(value.recommendationId, std::move(value)).second)
   297	            throw std::runtime_error(
   298	                "campaign_outcome_assessment_duplicate_source_record");
   299	    }
   300	    return result;
   301	}

   303	std::map<long long, ExperimentRecord> LoadExperiments(
   304	    pqxx::transaction_base& transaction,
   305	    const std::set<long long>& experimentIds)
   306	{
   307	    if (experimentIds.empty()) return {};
   308	    auto [placeholders, parameters] = IdPlaceholders(experimentIds);
   309	    const std::size_t timeZoneParameter = experimentIds.size() + 1;
   310	    parameters.append(kRecommendationDateTimeZone);
   311	    const std::string timeZone = "$" +
   312	        std::to_string(timeZoneParameter);
   313	    const pqxx::result rows = transaction.exec(
   314	        "SELECT experiment_id,symbol,prediction_horizon,c_next_threshold,"
   315	        "CASE WHEN infer_start IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_char(infer_start AT "
   316	        "TIME ZONE " + timeZone + ",'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS infer_start,"
   317	        "CASE WHEN infer_end IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_char(infer_end AT "
   318	        "TIME ZONE " + timeZone + ",'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS infer_end,"
   319	        "last_model_id FROM experiment WHERE experiment_id IN (" +
   320	        placeholders + ") ORDER BY experiment_id;",
   321	        parameters);
   322	    std::map<long long, ExperimentRecord> result;
   323	    for (const auto& row : rows)
   324	    {
   325	        ExperimentRecord value;
   326	        value.experimentId = row["experiment_id"].as<long long>();
   327	        value.symbol = row["symbol"].as<std::string>();
   328	        value.predictionHorizon =
   329	            row["prediction_horizon"].as<int>();
   330	        value.threshold = row["c_next_threshold"].as<double>();
   331	        value.inferenceRangeStart = OptionalText(row, "infer_start");
   332	        value.inferenceRangeEnd = OptionalText(row, "infer_end");
   333	        value.lastModelId = OptionalValue<long long>(row, "last_model_id");
   334	        if (!result.emplace(value.experimentId, std::move(value)).second)
   335	            throw std::runtime_error(
   336	                "campaign_outcome_assessment_duplicate_experiment_record");
   337	    }
   338	    return result;
   339	}

   387	        value.windowSize = row["window_size"].as<int>();
   388	        value.labelRuleId = row["label_rule_id"].as<int>();
   389	        value.targetType = row["target_type"].as<int>();
   390	        value.rangeStart = row["from_date"].as<std::string>();
   391	        value.rangeEnd = row["to_date"].as<std::string>();
   392	        value.status = row["status"].as<std::string>();
   393	        result.push_back(std::move(value));

   395	    return result;

   455	std::vector<const InferenceRecord*> ExactInferenceRecords(
   456	    const std::vector<InferenceRecord>& records,
   457	    const InferenceSelection& selection,
   458	    long long modelId,
   459	    bool completedOnly)
   460	{
   461	    std::vector<const InferenceRecord*> exact;
   462	    if (!selection.rangeStart || !selection.rangeEnd)
   463	        return exact;
   464	    for (const auto& record : records)
   465	    {
   466	        if (record.modelId == modelId &&
   467	            record.symbol == selection.symbol &&
   468	            record.predictionHorizon == selection.predictionHorizon &&
   469	            record.threshold == selection.threshold &&
   470	            record.rangeStart == *selection.rangeStart &&
   471	            record.rangeEnd == *selection.rangeEnd &&
   472	            (!completedOnly || record.status == "completed"))
   473	            exact.push_back(&record);
   474	    }
   475	    return exact;
   476	}

   514	    catch (const std::exception&)
   515	    {
   516	        consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   517	        return std::nullopt;
   518	    }
   519	}

+class CanonicalReader
+{
+public:
+    explicit CanonicalReader(std::string_view text) : text_(text) {}
+
+    void Expect(std::string_view expected)
+    {
+        if (!text_.substr(position_).starts_with(expected))
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        position_ += expected.size();
+    }
+
+    std::string_view ReadUntil(std::string_view delimiter)
+    {
+        const std::size_t found = text_.find(delimiter, position_);
+        if (found == std::string_view::npos)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, found - position_);
+        position_ = found + delimiter.size();
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Read(std::size_t length)
+    {
+        if (length > text_.size() - position_)
+            throw std::invalid_argument(
+                "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+        const auto value = text_.substr(position_, length);
+        position_ += length;
+        return value;
+    }
+
+    std::string_view Remaining() const
+    {
+        return text_.substr(position_);
+    }
+
+private:
+    std::string_view text_;
+    std::size_t position_ = 0;
+};
+
+template <typename Integer>
+Integer ParseCanonicalInteger(std::string_view text)
+{
+    Integer value{};
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(
+        text.data(), text.data() + text.size(), value);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        std::to_string(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+double ParseCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    double value = 0.0;
+    const auto result = std::from_chars(text.data(),
+        text.data() + text.size(), value, std::chars_format::general);
+    if (text.empty() || result.ec != std::errc{} ||
+        result.ptr != text.data() + text.size() ||
+        CanonicalRecommendationDouble(value) != text)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return value;
+}
+
+std::optional<double> ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalDouble(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<long long> ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return ParseCanonicalInteger<long long>(text);
+}
+
+std::optional<std::string> ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+    std::string_view text)
+{
+    if (text == "NULL") return std::nullopt;
+    return CanonicalExperimentDateText(std::string{text});
+}
+
+ExperimentInvocationConfiguration ParseSourceInvocation(
+    const std::string& canonical)
+{
+    CanonicalReader invocation{canonical};
+    invocation.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_invocation_v2;"
+        "semantic_configuration_length=");
+    const std::size_t semanticLength = ParseCanonicalInteger<std::size_t>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";semantic_configuration="));
+    const std::string semantic{invocation.Read(semanticLength)};
+    invocation.Expect(";checkpoint_interval=");
+    const int checkpointInterval = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        invocation.ReadUntil(";resume_model_id="));
+    const auto resumeModelId = ParseOptionalCanonicalLongLong(
+        invocation.Remaining());
+
+    CanonicalReader configuration{semantic};
+    configuration.Expect(
+        "experiment_recommendation_semantic_configuration_v3;symbol=");
+    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration parsed;
+    parsed.configuration.symbol = std::string{
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";prediction_horizon=")};
+    parsed.configuration.predictionHorizon = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";label_threshold="));
+    parsed.configuration.labelThreshold = ParseCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";core_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.coreLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";head_lr_mult="));
+    parsed.configuration.headLrMult = ParseOptionalCanonicalDouble(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";target_epochs="));
+    parsed.configuration.targetEpochs = ParseCanonicalInteger<int>(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";train_start_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.trainStartDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";train_end_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.trainEndDate = CanonicalExperimentDateText(
+        std::string{configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_start_date=")});
+    parsed.configuration.inferStartDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.ReadUntil(";infer_end_date="));
+    parsed.configuration.inferEndDate = ParseOptionalCanonicalDate(
+        configuration.Remaining());
+    parsed.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
+    parsed.resumeModelId = resumeModelId;
+
+    const auto validated = BuildRecommendationInvocationIdentity(parsed);
+    if (validated.canonicalText != canonical)
+        throw std::invalid_argument(
+            "campaign_outcome_assessment_source_invocation_invalid");
+    return validated.invocation;
+}

+class StreamStateGuard
+{
+public:
+    explicit StreamStateGuard(std::ostream& stream)
+        : stream_(stream), flags_(stream.flags()),
+          precision_(stream.precision()), locale_(stream.getloc()) {}

   548	std::optional<SourceEvidence> BuildSourceEvidence(
   549	    const RecommendationCampaignStatusMember& member,
   550	    const std::map<long long, SourceRecord>& sources,
   551	    const std::map<long long,
   552	        const PersistedRecommendationConversionProposal*>& proposals,
   553	    const std::map<long long, std::optional<long long>>& models,
   554	    const std::vector<InferenceRecord>& inferenceRecords,
   555	    const std::vector<AnalysisRecord>& analysisRecords,
   556	    Consistency& consistency)
   557	{
   558	    const auto source = sources.find(member.recommendationId);
   559	    const auto proposal = proposals.find(member.proposalId);
   560	    if (source == sources.end() || proposal == proposals.end() ||
   561	        source->second.sourceExperimentId != member.sourceExperimentId)
   562	    {
   563	        consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   564	        return std::nullopt;
   565	    }
   566	
   567	    ExperimentInvocationConfiguration sourceInvocation;
   568	    try
   569	    {
   570	        sourceInvocation = ParseSourceInvocation(
   571	            proposal->second->proposal.sourceInvocationCanonical);
   572	    }
   573	    catch (const std::exception&)
   574	    {
   575	        consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   576	        return std::nullopt;
   577	    }
   578	    try
   579	    {
   580	        if (EA::CanonicalSymbol::Normalize(source->second.sourceSymbol) !=
   581	                sourceInvocation.configuration.symbol ||
   582	            source->second.sourcePredictionHorizon !=
   583	                sourceInvocation.configuration.predictionHorizon)
   584	            consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   585	    }
   586	    catch (const std::exception&)
   587	    {
   588	        consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   589	    }
   590	    if (proposal->second->proposal.recommendationId !=
   591	            member.recommendationId ||
   592	        proposal->second->proposal.sourceExperimentId !=
   593	            member.sourceExperimentId)
   594	    {
   595	        consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   596	        return std::nullopt;
   597	    }
   598	
   599	    if (!source->second.sourceModelId) return std::nullopt;
   600	    if (*source->second.sourceModelId <= 0)
   601	    {
   602	        consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   603	        return std::nullopt;
   604	    }
   605	
   606	    const long long modelId = *source->second.sourceModelId;
   607	    const auto model = models.find(modelId);
   608	    if (model == models.end() || !model->second ||
   609	        model->second != std::optional<long long>{member.sourceExperimentId})
   610	        consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   611	
   612	    const auto exactInference = ExactInferenceRecords(
   613	        inferenceRecords, SelectionFrom(sourceInvocation), modelId, true);
   614	    if (exactInference.size() != 1)
   615	    {
   616	        if (exactInference.size() > 1)
   617	            consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   618	        return std::nullopt;
   619	    }
   620	    const auto context = ContextFrom(*exactInference.front(), consistency);
   621	    if (!context) return std::nullopt;
   622	
   623	    bool analysisIdentityPresent = false;
   624	    std::optional<long long> sourceAnalysisId =
   625	        source->second.sourceAnalysisId;
   626	    if (sourceAnalysisId && *sourceAnalysisId <= 0)
   627	    {
   628	        consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   629	        sourceAnalysisId.reset();
   630	    }
   631	    if (sourceAnalysisId)
   632	    {
   633	        const auto found = std::find_if(analysisRecords.begin(),
   634	            analysisRecords.end(), [&](const AnalysisRecord& record)
   635	        {
   636	            return record.analysisId == *sourceAnalysisId;
   637	        });
   638	        if (found != analysisRecords.end())
   639	        {
   640	            analysisIdentityPresent = found->experimentId ==
   641	                    member.sourceExperimentId &&
   642	                found->modelId == source->second.sourceModelId &&
   643	                found->scope == "final" && found->status == "completed";
   644	            if (!analysisIdentityPresent)
   645	                consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   646	        }
   647	        else
   648	            consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   649	    }
   650	
   651	    const bool metricIdentityPresent =
   652	        analysisIdentityPresent || sourceAnalysisId.has_value();
   653	    return SourceEvidence(member.sourceExperimentId,
   654	        source->second.sourceModelId, sourceAnalysisId, *context,
   655	        MetricCollection(Metrics(source->second.inferenceAccuracy,
   656	            source->second.leaderScore, metricIdentityPresent,
   657	            consistency)));

   660	std::optional<ResultEvidence> BuildResultEvidence(
   661	    const RecommendationCampaignStatusMember& member,
   662	    const std::map<long long, ExperimentRecord>& experiments,
   663	    const std::map<long long, std::optional<long long>>& models,
   664	    const std::vector<InferenceRecord>& inferenceRecords,
   665	    const std::vector<AnalysisRecord>& analysisRecords,
   666	    Consistency& consistency)
   667	{
   668	    std::vector<ResultIdentity> identities;
   669	    std::optional<Context> context;
   670	    std::vector<Metric> metrics;
   671	
   672	    if (member.experimentId && member.modelId)
   673	    {
   674	        const auto experiment = experiments.find(*member.experimentId);
   675	        const auto model = models.find(*member.modelId);
   676	        if (model == models.end() || !model->second ||
   677	            model->second != member.experimentId)
   678	            consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   679	        if (experiment != experiments.end())
   680	        {
   681	            const auto exactInference = ExactInferenceRecords(
   682	                inferenceRecords, SelectionFrom(experiment->second),
   683	                *member.modelId, false);
   684	            for (const auto* record : exactInference)
   685	                if (record->id > 0)
   686	                    identities.emplace_back(
   687	                        "inference_eval_result", record->id);
   688	            if (exactInference.size() == 1)
   689	            {
   690	                const auto mapped = ContextFrom(
   691	                    *exactInference.front(), consistency);
   692	                if (mapped) context.emplace(*mapped);
   693	            }
   694	            else if (exactInference.size() > 1)
   695	                consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   696	
   697	            const auto exactAnalysis = ExactAnalysisRecords(analysisRecords,
   698	                *member.experimentId, *member.modelId);
   699	            for (const auto* record : exactAnalysis)
   700	                if (record->analysisId > 0)
   701	                    identities.emplace_back(
   702	                        "experiment_analysis_result", record->analysisId);
   703	            if (exactAnalysis.size() == 1)
   704	                metrics = Metrics(exactAnalysis.front()->inferenceAccuracy,
   705	                    exactAnalysis.front()->leaderScore, true, consistency);
   706	            else if (exactAnalysis.size() > 1)
   707	                consistency = Consistency::Inconsistent;
   708	        }
   709	    }
   710	
   711	    const bool succeeded = member.terminalResult ==
   712	        RecommendationCampaignStatusTerminalResult::succeeded;
   713	    if (!succeeded && identities.empty()) return std::nullopt;
   714	    return ResultEvidence(member.experimentId, member.modelId,
   715	        std::move(identities), std::move(context),
   716	        MetricCollection(std::move(metrics)));
   717	}

   719	std::vector<ScientificMember> LoadScientificMembers(
   720	    pqxx::transaction_base& transaction,
   721	    const RecommendationCampaignStatusSnapshot& status)
   722	{
   723	    std::vector<long long> recommendationIds;
   724	    std::vector<long long> proposalIds;
   725	    std::set<long long> experimentIds;
   726	    std::set<long long> modelIds;
   727	    recommendationIds.reserve(status.members.size());
   728	    proposalIds.reserve(status.members.size());
   729	    for (const auto& member : status.members)
   730	    {
   731	        recommendationIds.push_back(member.recommendationId);
   732	        proposalIds.push_back(member.proposalId);
   733	        experimentIds.insert(member.sourceExperimentId);
   734	        if (member.experimentId) experimentIds.insert(*member.experimentId);
   735	    }
   736	    const auto sources = LoadSources(transaction, recommendationIds);
   737	    const auto proposalValues =
   738	        ListRecommendationConversionProposalsByIds(transaction, proposalIds);
   739	    std::map<long long, const PersistedRecommendationConversionProposal*>
   740	        proposals;
   741	    for (const auto& proposal : proposalValues)
   742	        if (!proposals.emplace(proposal.proposalId, &proposal).second)
   743	            throw std::runtime_error(
   744	                "campaign_outcome_assessment_duplicate_proposal_record");
   745	    for (const auto& [unused, source] : sources)
   746	    {
   747	        static_cast<void>(unused);
   748	        if (source.sourceModelId) modelIds.insert(*source.sourceModelId);
   749	    }
   750	    for (const auto& member : status.members)
   751	        if (member.modelId) modelIds.insert(*member.modelId);
   752	
   753	    const auto experiments = LoadExperiments(transaction, experimentIds);
   754	    const auto models = LoadModels(transaction, modelIds);
   755	    const auto inferenceRecords =
   756	        LoadInferenceRecords(transaction, modelIds);
   757	    const auto analysisRecords =
   758	        LoadAnalysisRecords(transaction, experimentIds);
   759	
   760	    std::vector<ScientificMember> result;
   761	    result.reserve(status.members.size());
   762	    for (const auto& member : status.members)
   763	    {
   764	        Consistency consistency = Consistency::Consistent;
   765	        auto sourceEvidence = BuildSourceEvidence(member, sources, proposals,
   766	            models, inferenceRecords, analysisRecords, consistency);
   767	        auto resultEvidence = BuildResultEvidence(member, experiments,
   768	            models, inferenceRecords, analysisRecords,
   769	            consistency);
   770	        result.push_back({member.memberOrdinal, consistency,
   771	            std::move(sourceEvidence), std::move(resultEvidence)});
   772	    }
   773	    return result;
   774	}
